observations: A used gearbox with a heavy layer of dirt and grime.
The housing appears to be a 5-speed automatic transmission.
The output shaft at the bottom is visibly rusted and corroded.
The gearbox is resting on a dark, possibly asphalt, surface.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI GEARUP INC.' is overlaid on the image.

claims.evidence: The origin cannot be confirmed from a photo of a used part.
No Ford logo or model plate is visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The gearbox may be a generic or used part rather than a genuine original equipment unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the stamped part number on the casing.

risks.risk: The output shaft may be severely damaged or seized.
risks.proof: A video showing the shaft being spun by hand or a photo of the shaft in a clean environment.

risks.risk: Internal gears or synchronizers may be stripped or damaged.
risks.proof: A video of the gearbox being shifted through all gears.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the stamped part number on the gearbox casing.
Video of the gearbox being shifted through all gears to check for internal damage.
Photo of the output shaft to check for rust or wear.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
